## Advanced brain scanning, out of the hospital and into the field.

solution built for emergency responders, remote communities, sports medicine, and the military.
Backed by CT-level performance, NIRD® technology gives you the confidence to act quickly, when every
minute counts.

## 93% of Head CTs are Negative for Bleeding. Start Smarter.

The NIRD® uses near-infrared light to scan the brain for signs of bleeding after a traumatic
incident. By analyzing how the light interacts with brain tissue, our device can detect acute
hematomas in minutes.

## Accurately identify up to 98% of acute subdural and epidural hematomas in minutes.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® technology gives frontline teams the clarity they need to make faster, smarter
decisions. Whether you’re in a rural clinic, an ambulance, or a military setting, it brings
hospital-grade insight to wherever care begins.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

Astam Diagnostics manufactures a wide range of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits and medical devices,
including Biochemistry Reagents, Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits (Immunochromatography), Immunology kits,
and advanced laboratory consumables for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

 

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

For wholesale distribution, laboratory tenders, or bulk supply requirements, interested parties can
fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

## Why intracranial hemorrhage detection is vital at point of care?

**Intracranial hemorrhage detection**

**The key to complete point of care testing of trauma patients**

Point-of-care diagnosis is key to providing early treatment. A fast and non-invasive screening test
of trauma patients at the site results in fast triaging which allows for significantly improved
diagnostics and treatment process.

But complete point-of-care testing that tests for brain injury remains elusive today because the
head trauma patients are missed during triage in case the patient has sustained no external injuries
or is not exhibiting any clinical symptom.

Glasgow coma scale has proved to be a very effective triaging methodology in acute traumatic brain
injury when a patient is presented with clinical symptoms, however it remains inconclusive in mild
traumatic brain injury especially when the patients are asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic due to
technology barrier that can detect an injury in absence of symptoms. Once this is solved, a complete
point of care diagnosis of trauma patients will become possible.

Each year more than 50 million suffer from traumatic brain injury in the world and $76.5 billion are
spent by the US alone in management of these patients.

Patients wait for several hours before clinical symptoms arise, and doctors sometimes make critical
decisions with incomplete information.

Although CT scanners are very reliable diagnostic tools for intracranial hemorrhage detection, these
cannot be deployed onsite for mass screening owing to their infrastructure requirement, exposure to
ionizing radiation and need of a radiologist, which creates a huge demand for an objective
assessment of the injury with a portable device that can be used by a paramedic or semi skilled
staff.

Cerebo combines class-leading detection accuracy with ease-of-use, compact design, and pricing
tailored to the point-of-care market. Our solution takes minutes to run, can be performed by a
technician with minimal training and doesn't require cumbersome testing setup to generate the
result.

## Is it or Is it Not?

[brain internal bleeding]

It's 3 am and a family visits the trauma centre, they have met with an accident. They all have some
external bruises and the kid has a mild headache. Is it serious? Do you need to rush them to urgent
care, to the CT scan, or neither? Is it worth risking the delay if you aren’t sure? Cerebo helps
answer these questions by letting you know if the brain is bleeding internally. Right when you need
it. Right at the site.

# The Comprehensive Solution to Traumatic Brain Injury

**Led by pioneers in the industry, BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach is creating the new
gold standard.**

## Our Approach

The BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach aims to aid clinicians with diagnosis of mTBI and
provide information regarding the likelihood of symptoms post injury.

Our approach includes blood biomarker panels that are available on both a point of care instrument
and standard laboratory systems, as well as neurocognitive testing.

Our goal is to provide objective evidence of injury and a prognosis report of a patient’s likelihood
of post-injury symptoms occurrence. Other relevant modalities will continue to be assessed.

[Explore our Approach][11]
[BRAINBox Solutions Blood Collection Icon]

#### Blood Biomarker Panels

We test for a series of specific biomarkers which cover multiple aspects of the impact of an injury.
The aim is to incorporate these biomarkers into an objective score, to increase accuracy of
diagnosis and prognosis of post-injury outcomes.

[BRAINBox Solutions Neurocognitive Testing]

#### Neurocognitive Testing

An easy to use, tablet-based series of validated tools are incorporated into the AI-driven score to
provide insights into the functional impact of the injury.

[BRAINBox Solutions Point of Care Icon]

#### Point of Care Instrument

Our point of care instrument will utilize advanced detection technology to generate quantitative
biomarker measurements with high precision within minutes.

#### Our strategy, clinical data, and execution are uniformly aligned with the new framework for
#### classifying Traumatic Brain Injury.

###### Read more on the website of National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
###### (September 29, 2025): [**New Framework for Classifying Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Could
###### Transform Patient Care**][12]


#### Watch the video to learn more about our approach.

### Meet Frank Peacock MD, FACEP, FACC, FESC

*Professor, Vice Chair for Research
Henry JN Taub Department of Emergency Medicine
Baylor College of Medicine
Houston, Texas*

Dr. Peacock is the Principal Investigator of HeadSMART II. He comments on:

• The state of TBI diagnosis and the need to change the current standard of care to improve the
outcomes for patients.
• The advances in brain science and prognosis
• The importance of functional and physiologic testing done simultaneously to identify patients that
will benefit physicians ability to help with further interventions.

**Learn more by visiting [ClinicalTrials.gov][13] and using the following identifier: NCT04423198.**

# The Comprehensive Solution to Traumatic Brain Injury

**Led by pioneers in the industry, BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach is creating the new
gold standard.**

## Our Approach

The BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach aims to aid clinicians with diagnosis of mTBI and
provide information regarding the likelihood of symptoms post injury.

Our approach includes blood biomarker panels that are available on both a point of care instrument
and standard laboratory systems, as well as neurocognitive testing.

Our goal is to provide objective evidence of injury and a prognosis report of a patient’s likelihood
of post-injury symptoms occurrence. Other relevant modalities will continue to be assessed.

[Explore our Approach][11]
[BRAINBox Solutions Blood Collection Icon]

#### Blood Biomarker Panels

We test for a series of specific biomarkers which cover multiple aspects of the impact of an injury.
The aim is to incorporate these biomarkers into an objective score, to increase accuracy of
diagnosis and prognosis of post-injury outcomes.

[BRAINBox Solutions Neurocognitive Testing]

#### Neurocognitive Testing

An easy to use, tablet-based series of validated tools are incorporated into the AI-driven score to
provide insights into the functional impact of the injury.

[BRAINBox Solutions Point of Care Icon]

#### Point of Care Instrument

Our point of care instrument will utilize advanced detection technology to generate quantitative
biomarker measurements with high precision within minutes.

#### Our strategy, clinical data, and execution are uniformly aligned with the new framework for
#### classifying Traumatic Brain Injury.

###### Read more on the website of National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
###### (September 29, 2025): [**New Framework for Classifying Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Could
###### Transform Patient Care**][12]


#### Watch the video to learn more about our approach.

### Meet Frank Peacock MD, FACEP, FACC, FESC

*Professor, Vice Chair for Research
Henry JN Taub Department of Emergency Medicine
Baylor College of Medicine
Houston, Texas*

Dr. Peacock is the Principal Investigator of HeadSMART II. He comments on:

• The state of TBI diagnosis and the need to change the current standard of care to improve the
outcomes for patients.
• The advances in brain science and prognosis
• The importance of functional and physiologic testing done simultaneously to identify patients that
will benefit physicians ability to help with further interventions.

**Learn more by visiting [ClinicalTrials.gov][13] and using the following identifier: NCT04423198.**

## What is a BCI and why?

Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are systems which can isolate specific brain signals to interpret
cognitive and sensory-motor functions into physical movement for patients who suffer from paralysis.

## Background

According to the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center, there are about 11,000 new cases of
spinal cord injury every year  and 270,000 victims residing in the United States. With this issue at
hand, BrainCheck is dedicated to redefining brain computer interfaces by addressing reliability with
an emphasis on portability.  BrainCheck is composed of experienced innovators striving to develop
and design improvements within BCI technology with a focus on restoring hand gestures.

## Mission

The perspectives and values of BrainCheck were moulded by the collaborative minds of biomedical and
materials science engineers from the University of California, Irvine. Our mission is to empower
paralyzed patients to regain hand movements with the assistance of our portable, affordable, and
user-friendly brain computer interface.

## Diagnostic Services

Our comprehensive diagnostic services for TBI encompass the following
[Image]

### Eye Tracking

FDA-cleared eye-tracking assessments that objectively measure eye movements and brain function to
help identify potential neurological impairment after injury.

[Image]

### VNG

Comprehensive vestibular test that evaluates inner ear and balance system function as well as
cognitive impairments.

[Image]

### CNS

Objective measurements of cognitive performance, including memory, attention processing speed, and
executive function, to help identify changes following brain injury.

[Image]

### Biomarkers

Blood based brain injury biomarkers analyze specific proteins released after head trauma, offering
additional objective data to support diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

[Image]

### DTI

Advanced MRI technique that evaluated microscopic changes in brain white matter, helping detect
structural injury that may not appear on conventional imaging.

# 
# Offering Real Hope After Brain Injury

Our Mission is to Advocate, Educate, and Serve all Affected by Brain Injury

# **Welcome to BIHN**

We offer a supportive community for anyone impacted by brain injury including resources that help
survivors and caregivers find understanding, healing, and empowerment. Connect with our community,
share experiences, and explore real stories of resilience and hope. No one walks this path alone.

[Survivor Resources][31] [For Caregivers][32]

#### ** Connecting Us**

BIHN Community brings together more than 55,000 survivors, caregivers, and families. Through shared
experience, members connect with others who understand.

[ Join the Community][33]

#### ** Ending Isolation**

BIHN Support provides real time peer support through our virtual support groups. Each year thousands
attend to share experiences, build connection, and find strength together.

[View Support Groups][34]

#### ** Educating Us**

BIHN Education offers monthly learning sessions featuring professionals and survivor presenters who
share practical strategies for living well after brain injury.

[ Explore Education][35]

# Listen to Voices of Resilience: Audio Stories from the Heart

Explore our audio stories, where resilience and courage find their voice. These narratives provide a
glimpse into the lives of those affected by brain injury, highlighting their struggles, victories,
and hope. Ideal for anyone seeking inspiration, comfort, or community, our audio stories offer a
chance to listen, reflect, and connect. They're perfect for when you want to absorb storytelling
hands-free or just immerse in the journey of others.

[Listen to Stories][36]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Join Our Monthly Online Support Groups**

Join us for our BIHN Brain Injury Support Groups on Zoom, where we offer two distinct meetings each
month designed to support different members of the brain injury community. These sessions are a
chance to share experiences, gain understanding, and connect with others facing similar challenges
in a supportive and welcoming environment.

[Learn More][37]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Community Resources for Brain Injury Caregivers**

Being a caregiver is challenging, but you don’t have to face it alone. Our in-person and online
support groups are here to offer you connection, understanding, and guidance. Whether you need
someone to talk to, practical advice, or just a community that gets it, we’re here for you. Discover
our gatherings, social communities, and resources that make caregiving a bit more manageable and
supported.

[Learn More][38]
[bihn]

#### ** Our Facebook Family**

One of the world's largest online social communities offering support to those affected by brain
injury. 

[ Learn More ][39]
[Brain Injury books]

#### ** Brain Injury Books**

Browse the best brain injury books as recommended by survivors and those who love them!

[ Learn More ][40]
[brain injury blog]

#### ** BIHN Blog**

*Community Voices* is the official blog of BIHN, featuring survivor stories that remind us that
recovery is possible.

[ View Blog][41]

## Celebrating 13 Years of Hope!

BIHN celebrated a significant milestone on January 4th, 2026, commemorating twelve years of
dedicated service. We take pride in being the world's most engaged community, providing
comprehensive support to everyone impacted by brain injuries.

Our network is a welcoming space for survivors, their families, caregivers, and anyone seeking to
understand more about brain injuries. We warmly invite you to join us on this journey of hope,
healing, and learning.

[Join Us on Facebook>>>][42]

[Mobirise]

# Sign Up for Updates!

Stay connected with BIHN through our email newsletter. Sign up now to receive updates directly to
your inbox, including notifications of new stories shared by our community, reminders for upcoming
support group meetings, information on events, and much more.

# World leading supplier of innovative medical technology for patient monitoring

Since 1987, Compumedics’ strategy has focused on developing its core competency – Sleep Diagnostics
– which has enabled the company to become one of the leaders in this growing international
healthcare market. Today, Compumedics has evolved into one of the world’s leading suppliers of
medical technology for sleep and neuro diagnostics (including brain research) and ultrasonic blood
flow monitoring.

Compumedics’ technologies and products are distributed to clients around the globe, helping millions
of people who suffer from debilitating sleep, neurological and other healthcare problems.

Compumedics is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 2000 – ASX: CMP.

application, the Cortex team is determined to deliver a product that is both financially accessible

# Portable Brain Imaging

[ Interested? Let's talk ][6]

Cortirio’s mission is to save lives by developing low-cost, portable brain imaging. Our wearable
headset uses infrared light to map blood and automatically detect stroke and traumatic brain injury.
Faster and more accurate diagnosis saves time and lives.

[Brain scan]

## Technology

Infrared brain monitoring is a tool that has been used in medical research for many years.
Cortirio’s technology increases the spatial resolution of infrared monitoring to give true medical
imaging in a portable and wearable device. Like computer-aided tomography did for X-ray, we are
leveraging advances in technology to push an established technique for examining the brain to new
levels.

### Low-cost:

making imaging accessible to everyone

### Portable:

making imaging accessible everywhere

### Fast:

diagnosis on-site in 2 minutes

### Continuous monitoring:

raises alarm if patient deteriorates

# Portable Brain Imaging

[ Interested? Let's talk ][6]

Cortirio’s mission is to save lives by developing low-cost, portable brain imaging. Our wearable
headset uses infrared light to map blood and automatically detect stroke and traumatic brain injury.
Faster and more accurate diagnosis saves time and lives.

[Brain scan]

## Technology

Infrared brain monitoring is a tool that has been used in medical research for many years.
Cortirio’s technology increases the spatial resolution of infrared monitoring to give true medical
imaging in a portable and wearable device. Like computer-aided tomography did for X-ray, we are
leveraging advances in technology to push an established technique for examining the brain to new
levels.

### Low-cost:

making imaging accessible to everyone

### Portable:

making imaging accessible everywhere

### Fast:

diagnosis on-site in 2 minutes

### Continuous monitoring:

raises alarm if patient deteriorates

  to distinguish the different histologic subtypes and initiate appropriate treatment?

  soil, and light, are linked to an increased risk of cardiovascular morbidity and mortality.

# Accessible imaging, for every patient, everywhere

We aim to revolutionise stroke care worldwide.

# Developing a world first portable brain scanner

Bringing electromagnetic neurodiagnostics to the scene.
[ Learn more ][17]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the point-of-care

When stroke is suspected, rapid diagnosis is critical. Our world-first bedside electromagnetic
imaging device readily delivers imaging to the patient. Fast, AI-powered identification of stroke
type accelerates the appropriate treatment to better conserve brain matter.
[ How it works ][18]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the patient, wherever they are

###### Portable

Easily manoeuvred, easily stored, just like a cart Ultrasound

###### Safe

No ionizing radiation, no ferromagnetism, no special infrastructure or shielding requirements

###### Bedside operation

Perform scans at the bedside, without needing to move equipment or transport the patient

###### Fast

Scans and neurodiagnostic output obtained in just a few minutes

###### Easy to operate

One headset for all head sizes, simple pre-set positioning, push to scan

#### emu^{™} Brain Scanner

Detect clinically significant changes, at the bedside, when time matters.

#### First Responder Brain Scanner

Ultra light weight device embedded in standard road and air ambulances to deliver pre-hospital
stroke diagnosis and care to patients regardless of location.

Disclaimer: Neither the emu^{™} or first responder devices are available for sale or clinical use.
The devices’ safety, effectiveness and compliance
with regulatory requirements have not yet been evaluated by any regulatory authority.

# Complex Mental Health and Acquired Brain Injury service provider

[Services][6]

### About Us

### Maple House is a community based, purpose built, independent rehabilitation service for men with
### complex mental health needs including acquired brain injury. It is situated in the heart of
### Warrington with excellent transport links and is easily accessible. We focus on nurturing a
### positive and therapeutic environment that enables recovery and helps people fulfil their
### individual potential.

#### Services

Maple House is a 21 bed inpatient service that provides high quality, holistic, person-centred
rehabilitative care and specialised treatment for men with complex mental health needs due to mental
illness and/or acquired brain injury.

#### Our Goal

Our goal is to enable each of the men in our care to achieve meaningful and sustainable recovery and
fulfil his individual potential to the maximum extent. We help them make positive change in their
lives and to gain greater independence, long-term mental wellbeing and successful reintegration into
their community at their earliest opportunity.

#### We Offer

We offer an effective alternative to higher levels of secure care and aim to make a positive
difference in the lives of all those we support. With an individualised, person centred approach; we
can tailor the rehabilitation programme to the goals of the men in our care. Where appropriate and
agreed, we can also provide a managed individualised pathway to our affiliate supported living
service.

### Service Inclusion Criteria

> Males aged 18 years plus.
> 
> Informal, Detained under the Mental Health Act or Mental capacity Act
> 
> Complex mental health needs due to mental illness or acquired brain injury
> 
> May have more than one diagnosis
> 
> May be deemed a risk to themselves and/or others
> 
> May have a history of treatment resistance
> 
> Deemed suitable for rehabilitation in a non-secure setting

# When Speed and Accuracy Matter, NanoDx™ Delivers

The NanoDx™ System is a first-of-its-kind diagnostic technology that combines nanotechnology and
biochemistry in a nano biosensor platform to address unmet testing needs.

### Clinical Value

Accelerate treatment decisions with accurate, real-time test results.

### Operational Value

Treat more patients in less time and bring the test to the patient.

### Financial Value

Reduce costly lab testing, avoid unnecessary diagnostic procedures.

### Health Equity

Bring accurate testing to both developed and underserved areas.

### Rapid Innovation

New test applications developed in just 6 to 9 months.

### Versatility

From military use to urgent care to sports medicine and more.

## One Platform, Multiple Applications

Patented nano biosensor technology enables accurate detection of biomarkers with a small blood
sample, in minutes. Extensive multiplexing capability and readily adjustable biomarker panel
configuration enable applications across a wide range of clinical indications.

[Learn More][24]

**Potential Future Applications (Directional)**

## First Focus: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)

Our TBI test, the first in an expanding portfolio, addresses the need for an accurate, quantitative
assessment of brain injury.* It replaces subjective evaluation with a real-time measurement of three
key TBI biomarkers.

[Learn More about TBI][25]

## What is Portapps ?

**Portapps** is a collection of [portable applications][10] for Windows. You can download your
favorite application as a portable setup or a 7z archive. Each portable app is executed through a
wrapper `[appname]-portable.exe` written in [Golang][11].

It is free and open source and always will be . All kinds of contributions are welcome ! The most
basic way to show your support is to star the project, or to raise issues You can also support this
project by [**becoming a sponsor on GitHub**][12] or by making a [Paypal donation][13] to ensure
this journey continues indefinitely!

# Portapps

Collection of portable apps for Windows [   Apps ][8] [   Github ][9]

## What is Portapps ?

**Portapps** is a collection of [portable applications][10] for Windows. You can download your
favorite application as a portable setup or a 7z archive. Each portable app is executed through a
wrapper `[appname]-portable.exe` written in [Golang][11].

It is free and open source and always will be . All kinds of contributions are welcome ! The most
basic way to show your support is to star the project, or to raise issues You can also support this
project by [**becoming a sponsor on GitHub**][12] or by making a [Paypal donation][13] to ensure
this journey continues indefinitely!

#### about Precision MRI Group

## We are the ultimate in convenience and technology.

At Precision MRI Group, we place a strong focus on patient safety, comfort, and quality care. Our
friendly and knowledgeable team creates a calm and professional environment, ensuring every patient
feels supported throughout their visit. We are proud to offer advanced MRI services along with DTI
(Diffusion Tensor Imaging), a specialized form of imaging that provides detailed insights into brain
structure and neurological conditions.

Our Board Certified Radiologist delivers accurate MRI and DTI reports within 24 to 48 hours, with
immediate processing available for urgent cases. To make your experience even more convenient, we
offer free transportation upon request and flexible scheduling, including late evening and weekend
appointments to fit your lifestyle.

With English, Spanish, and Creole-speaking staff, we are here to assist with all your medical
imaging needs and ensure clear communication every step of the way. At Precision MRI Group, our goal
is to make your MRI and DTI experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. Call our caring team
today to schedule your appointment!

[ More About Us ][29]
[Precision MRI]
what we do

## Comprehensive MRI and DTI Scans

Precision MRI provides advanced diagnostic imaging using state-of-the-art MRI technology for
accurate and timely results. Our services support neurological, musculoskeletal, and whole-body
imaging with a focus on patient comfort and precise clinical insight.

### GE HiField 1.5 MRI

The GE HiField 1.5 Tesla MRI system provides high-resolution imaging for accurate diagnosis. It
supports neuro, musculoskeletal, and abdominal imaging with faster scans, improved comfort, and
clear results for confident treatment planning.

[ View Details ][30]
[ [Diffusion Tensor Imaging] ][31]

### Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)

Precision MRI is expanding its neurological imaging with Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI), an advanced
MRI technique used to evaluate traumatic brain injury, stroke, neurodegenerative disease, and
complex neurological conditions not visible on standard MRI.

[ View Details ][32]
[ [Inclusivity in Imaging: Navigating Open MRI for Bariatric and Plus-Size Patients] ][33]

### Tesla MRI

Tesla MRI systems, including 1.5T and 3T, provide exceptional image clarity for accurate diagnosis.
Higher-strength 3T imaging captures fine details, supporting advanced detection in oncology,
cardiology, and functional imaging for more precise, personalized care.

[ View Details ][34]

## What Our MRI Centers Offer

Visit one of our four offices conveniently located throughout South Florida. We have offices in
Pembroke Pines, Cypress Creek, Lake Worth and Port St. Lucie.

### LATE NIGHT & WEEKEND APPOINTMENTS

Our caring personnel will schedule your MRI appointment at a time that best accommodates your needs.
Even if it’s after hours or on a weekend.

### SAME DAY APPOINTMENTS AVAILABLE

Precision MRI’s Board Certified Radiologist offers a 24-48 hour turnaround time on your MRI report,
with immediate results available upon request.

### TRANSPORTATION PROVIDED ON REQUEST

We place a high premium on providing the utmost in quality patient care. That’s why we offer free
transportation for our patients.

FREE E-BOOK

## Take Control of Your Health Today!

Experience the difference with Precision MRI Group. Schedule your MRI with us and benefit from our
expertise, efficiency, convenience, and personalized care. Don’t wait prioritize your health and
well-being now.

[ Contact Us ][35]

## Welcome to StressTherapy Solutions

 



StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is an educational marketing company; specializing in workshops and
lectures on the subjects of biofeedback, EEG (electroencephalograph) brainwave training, QEEG
(Quantitative electroencephalograph), Database Guided Training, sLORETA Training, clinical ethics
and marketing guidance, personal mind fitness, and brainwave monitored meditation and neurofeedback
(EEG biofeedback) use in the clinical setting.

Since the 1980s, we have facilitated training and education by choosing independent specialists:
First with allopathics, then expanding to the neurofeedback community in 2001, to present workshops
to licensed practitioners, researchers, and educators. StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is the only
company to introduce the Global Neurofeedback Initiative, a collective that aims to promote
worldwide excellence, certification, and consistency in neurofeedback education.

### **TCA Venture Group: Catalyzing the Startup Ecosystem**

TCA Venture Group (TCA), formerly known as Tech Coast Angels, is headquartered in Southern
California, plays a pivotal role in fueling the growth of the startup ecosystem. With approximately
400 members and five angel funds, TCA has the resources and expertise to support startups through
seed, bridge, and early A-round funding.

TCA seeks companies with innovative solutions to meaningful problems—those that offer clear,
sustainable, and differentiated advantages. Our investments span a wide range of industries (see our
portfolio for details).

Beyond funding, TCA provides early-stage entrepreneurs with the critical tools for success:
connections, mentorship, knowledge, and operational support. While we work with startups across the
U.S. and Canada, we prioritize supporting California-based entrepreneurs with bold, game-changing
ideas.

Through our affiliation with over 50 angel groups nationwide, TCA has the ability to syndicate
deals, further amplifying the opportunities we create for startups.

**If you are an Entrepreneur seeking funding, let us help you to turn your vision into a sustainable
and successful business.**

[Apply Now!][74]

would like to become a member.**

[Join Now!][75]

events.**

* One of the largest and most active angel investment organizations in the U.S.
* About 400 members in six regional networks covering Orange County, Los Angeles, Pasadena, Inland
  Empire, Florida/Georgia plus members located in other cities across the US
* Affiliation with the **[Angel Syndication Network][76]** and **[Pegasus Angel Accelerator][77]**
* Members with diverse industry backgrounds, functional expertise, and management experience
* Entrepreneurs with start-up experience
* Business owners and corporate executives who have built companies and have walked in your shoes

## What We Bring
* Critical business connections
* Hands-on practical mentoring
* Assistance in building out management teams
* Help in raising additional venture capital funding

## What We’ve Done
* Investments in more than 540 companies since 1997
* Total investments in seed and early A round capital in excess of $300 million
* Portfolio companies which have attracted more than $2.2 billion in additional investment capital

investment-ready startups from those that are prematurely seeking capital. The conversation
highlights the importance of preparation, including building a credible team, validating
product-market fit, understanding customers, developing a concise elevator pitch, and establishing
realistic valuations before approaching investors. The hosts emphasize that investors fund execution
and evidence, not just ideas, and that founders who demonstrate focus, market understanding, and
coachability significantly improve their chances of raising capital. The discussion also explores
why investors frequently decline opportunities, including unrealistic financial projections, lack of
competitive analysis, poor capital planning, and founders who are unwilling to accept feedback.
Berkus and Friedman stress that entrepreneurs must understand the investment thesis of the investors
they are approaching and align their pitch accordingly. Key takeaways include the importance of
customer validation, realistic fundraising expectations, capital efficiency, and building long-term
relationships with investors rather than viewing fundraising as a transactional process.]

Turning Point provides confidential resources and support for individuals and families in Lehigh and
Northampton counties. In fiscal year 2024–2025, we served more than 3,772 Lehigh Valley residents
through our trauma-informed, inclusive programs, which include: a 24-hour Helpline, Emergency Safe
House, Empowerment Counseling and Groups, Legal Advocacy, Education and Training, and Medical
Advocacy.

## Advanced brain scanning, out of the hospital and into the field.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® (Near-Infrared Diffuse Reflectance) device is a lightweight, non-invasive
solution built for emergency responders, remote communities, sports medicine, and the military.
Backed by CT-level performance, NIRD® technology gives you the confidence to act quickly, when every
minute counts.

## 93% of Head CTs are Negative for Bleeding. Start Smarter.

The NIRD® uses near-infrared light to scan the brain for signs of bleeding after a traumatic
incident. By analyzing how the light interacts with brain tissue, our device can detect acute
hematomas in minutes.

## Accurately identify up to 98% of acute subdural and epidural hematomas in minutes.

ArcheOptix’s NIRD® technology gives frontline teams the clarity they need to make faster, smarter
decisions. Whether you’re in a rural clinic, an ambulance, or a military setting, it brings
hospital-grade insight to wherever care begins.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[ What types of diagnostic products does Astam Diagnostics manufacture?
][94]

Astam Diagnostics manufactures a wide range of In-Vitro Diagnostic (IVD) kits and medical devices,
including Biochemistry Reagents, Rapid Diagnostic Test Kits (Immunochromatography), Immunology kits,
and advanced laboratory consumables for hospitals and diagnostic centers.

 

[ Does Astam Diagnostics provide OEM and private label manufacturing services?
][95]

They offer end-to-end OEM and private label manufacturing services for IVD kits and medical devices,
custom-tailored to the formulations, packaging, branding, and regulatory compliance standards of
global healthcare brands.

 

[ What regulatory and quality certifications does your manufacturing facility hold?
][96]

The manufacturing plant operates under stringent international quality protocols. Astam Diagnostics
is ISO 13485:2016 certified, with products manufactured in compliance with CDSCO regulations and CE
certification standards.

 

[ How can global distributors or laboratories request a bulk supply or custom quote?
][97]

For wholesale distribution, laboratory tenders, or bulk supply requirements, interested parties can
fill out the corporate enquiry form on the website or email the B2B procurement cell directly. The
company provides scalable logistics for both domestic (Pan-India) and international shipments.

[ Do you ensure batch-to-batch consistency for your biochemistry reagents and rapid kits?
][98]

The in-house R&D facility and quality assurance teams perform rigorous analytical and clinical
evaluations on every batch, guaranteeing exceptional sensitivity, specificity, and long-term
stability across all diagnostic products.

[ Where can individuals or small clinics buy retail quantities of your products online?
][99]

While the main website handles bulk corporate contracts, a dedicated e-commerce storefront is
available for retail orders. Small clinics, laboratories, and individual clients can purchase
selected medical devices at shop.astamdiagno.com.

matters.

## Why intracranial hemorrhage detection is vital at point of care?

**Intracranial hemorrhage detection**

**The key to complete point of care testing of trauma patients**

Point-of-care diagnosis is key to providing early treatment. A fast and non-invasive screening test
of trauma patients at the site results in fast triaging which allows for significantly improved
diagnostics and treatment process.

But complete point-of-care testing that tests for brain injury remains elusive today because the
head trauma patients are missed during triage in case the patient has sustained no external injuries
or is not exhibiting any clinical symptom.

Glasgow coma scale has proved to be a very effective triaging methodology in acute traumatic brain
injury when a patient is presented with clinical symptoms, however it remains inconclusive in mild
traumatic brain injury especially when the patients are asymptomatic or mildly symptomatic due to
technology barrier that can detect an injury in absence of symptoms. Once this is solved, a complete
point of care diagnosis of trauma patients will become possible.

Each year more than 50 million suffer from traumatic brain injury in the world and $76.5 billion are
spent by the US alone in management of these patients.

Patients wait for several hours before clinical symptoms arise, and doctors sometimes make critical
decisions with incomplete information.

Although CT scanners are very reliable diagnostic tools for intracranial hemorrhage detection, these
cannot be deployed onsite for mass screening owing to their infrastructure requirement, exposure to
ionizing radiation and need of a radiologist, which creates a huge demand for an objective
assessment of the injury with a portable device that can be used by a paramedic or semi skilled
staff.

Cerebo combines class-leading detection accuracy with ease-of-use, compact design, and pricing
tailored to the point-of-care market. Our solution takes minutes to run, can be performed by a
technician with minimal training and doesn't require cumbersome testing setup to generate the
result.

## Is it or Is it Not?

[brain internal bleeding]

It's 3 am and a family visits the trauma centre, they have met with an accident. They all have some
external bruises and the kid has a mild headache. Is it serious? Do you need to rush them to urgent
care, to the CT scan, or neither? Is it worth risking the delay if you aren’t sure? Cerebo helps
answer these questions by letting you know if the brain is bleeding internally. Right when you need
it. Right at the site.

# The Comprehensive Solution to Traumatic Brain Injury

**Led by pioneers in the industry, BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach is creating the new
gold standard.**

## Our Approach

The BRAINBox Solutions™ multi-modality approach aims to aid clinicians with diagnosis of mTBI and
provide information regarding the likelihood of symptoms post injury.

Our approach includes blood biomarker panels that are available on both a point of care instrument
and standard laboratory systems, as well as neurocognitive testing.

Our goal is to provide objective evidence of injury and a prognosis report of a patient’s likelihood
of post-injury symptoms occurrence. Other relevant modalities will continue to be assessed.

[Explore our Approach][11]
[BRAINBox Solutions Blood Collection Icon]

#### Blood Biomarker Panels

We test for a series of specific biomarkers which cover multiple aspects of the impact of an injury.
The aim is to incorporate these biomarkers into an objective score, to increase accuracy of
diagnosis and prognosis of post-injury outcomes.

[BRAINBox Solutions Neurocognitive Testing]

#### Neurocognitive Testing

An easy to use, tablet-based series of validated tools are incorporated into the AI-driven score to
provide insights into the functional impact of the injury.

[BRAINBox Solutions Point of Care Icon]

#### Point of Care Instrument

Our point of care instrument will utilize advanced detection technology to generate quantitative
biomarker measurements with high precision within minutes.

#### Our strategy, clinical data, and execution are uniformly aligned with the new framework for
#### classifying Traumatic Brain Injury.

###### Read more on the website of National Institute of Neurological Disorders and Stroke
###### (September 29, 2025): [**New Framework for Classifying Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI) Could
###### Transform Patient Care**][12]


#### Watch the video to learn more about our approach.

### Meet Frank Peacock MD, FACEP, FACC, FESC

*Professor, Vice Chair for Research
Henry JN Taub Department of Emergency Medicine
Baylor College of Medicine
Houston, Texas*

Dr. Peacock is the Principal Investigator of HeadSMART II. He comments on:

• The state of TBI diagnosis and the need to change the current standard of care to improve the
outcomes for patients.
• The advances in brain science and prognosis
• The importance of functional and physiologic testing done simultaneously to identify patients that
will benefit physicians ability to help with further interventions.

**Learn more by visiting [ClinicalTrials.gov][13] and using the following identifier: NCT04423198.**

## Clinical Trial

BRAINBox heads into pivotal trial of concussion diagnostic test with $23M in new funding

A new $23 million in funds gives BRAINBox Solutions Inc. a head start as it begins enrollment in the
pivotal clinical trial of its mild traumatic brain injury (TBI) diagnostic and prognostic test.

[Learn About Trial][14]

## What is a BCI and why?

Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are systems which can isolate specific brain signals to interpret
cognitive and sensory-motor functions into physical movement for patients who suffer from paralysis.

## Background

According to the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center, there are about 11,000 new cases of
spinal cord injury every year  and 270,000 victims residing in the United States. With this issue at
hand, BrainCheck is dedicated to redefining brain computer interfaces by addressing reliability with
an emphasis on portability.  BrainCheck is composed of experienced innovators striving to develop
and design improvements within BCI technology with a focus on restoring hand gestures.

## Mission

The perspectives and values of BrainCheck were moulded by the collaborative minds of biomedical and
materials science engineers from the University of California, Irvine. Our mission is to empower
paralyzed patients to regain hand movements with the assistance of our portable, affordable, and
user-friendly brain computer interface.

## What is a BCI and why?

Brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) are systems which can isolate specific brain signals to interpret
cognitive and sensory-motor functions into physical movement for patients who suffer from paralysis.

## Background

According to the National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center, there are about 11,000 new cases of
spinal cord injury every year  and 270,000 victims residing in the United States. With this issue at
hand, BrainCheck is dedicated to redefining brain computer interfaces by addressing reliability with
an emphasis on portability.  BrainCheck is composed of experienced innovators striving to develop
and design improvements within BCI technology with a focus on restoring hand gestures.

## Mission

The perspectives and values of BrainCheck were moulded by the collaborative minds of biomedical and
materials science engineers from the University of California, Irvine. Our mission is to empower
paralyzed patients to regain hand movements with the assistance of our portable, affordable, and
user-friendly brain computer interface.

## Diagnostic Services

[Image]

### Imaging Tests

Utilizing state-of-the-art technology Functional Testing: Assessing brain function and cognitive
abilities, including memory, attention, and problem-solving skills.

[Image]

### Neuropsychological Assessments

Comprehensive evaluations covering intelligence, memory, attention, processing speed, executive
function, language, and social cognition.

[Image]

### Imaging Vestibular and Balance Assessments

Evaluating balance, spatial orientation, and eye-head coordination.

[Image]

### Clinical History and Physical Examination

Assessing emotional well-being and mental health.

## Diagnostic Services

Our comprehensive diagnostic services for TBI encompass the following
[Image]

### Eye Tracking

FDA-cleared eye-tracking assessments that objectively measure eye movements and brain function to
help identify potential neurological impairment after injury.

[Image]

### VNG

Comprehensive vestibular test that evaluates inner ear and balance system function as well as
cognitive impairments.

[Image]

### CNS

Objective measurements of cognitive performance, including memory, attention processing speed, and
executive function, to help identify changes following brain injury.

[Image]

### Biomarkers

Blood based brain injury biomarkers analyze specific proteins released after head trauma, offering
additional objective data to support diagnosis and clinical decision-making.

[Image]

### DTI

Advanced MRI technique that evaluated microscopic changes in brain white matter, helping detect
structural injury that may not appear on conventional imaging.

Florida who have sustained an acquired brain injury (from either traumatic or non-traumatic causes)
by promoting effective awareness, education, outreach, treatment, prevention, advocacy, and support.

BIF is a chartered state affiliate of the Brain Injury Association of America (BIAA). Brain Injury
Florida, Inc., is a 501(c) (3) tax exempt organization incorporatted in Florida. The official
registration and financial information may be obtained from the [Florida Department of State][45].
Registration does not imply endorsement.

# 
# Offering Real Hope After Brain Injury

Our Mission is to Advocate, Educate, and Serve all Affected by Brain Injury

# **Welcome to BIHN**

We offer a supportive community for anyone impacted by brain injury including resources that help
survivors and caregivers find understanding, healing, and empowerment. Connect with our community,
share experiences, and explore real stories of resilience and hope. No one walks this path alone.

[Survivor Resources][31] [For Caregivers][32]

#### ** Connecting Us**

BIHN Community brings together more than 55,000 survivors, caregivers, and families. Through shared
experience, members connect with others who understand.

[ Join the Community][33]

#### ** Ending Isolation**

BIHN Support provides real time peer support through our virtual support groups. Each year thousands
attend to share experiences, build connection, and find strength together.

[View Support Groups][34]

#### ** Educating Us**

BIHN Education offers monthly learning sessions featuring professionals and survivor presenters who
share practical strategies for living well after brain injury.

[ Explore Education][35]

# Listen to Voices of Resilience: Audio Stories from the Heart

Explore our audio stories, where resilience and courage find their voice. These narratives provide a
glimpse into the lives of those affected by brain injury, highlighting their struggles, victories,
and hope. Ideal for anyone seeking inspiration, comfort, or community, our audio stories offer a
chance to listen, reflect, and connect. They're perfect for when you want to absorb storytelling
hands-free or just immerse in the journey of others.

[Listen to Stories][36]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Join Our Monthly Online Support Groups**

Join us for our BIHN Brain Injury Support Groups on Zoom, where we offer two distinct meetings each
month designed to support different members of the brain injury community. These sessions are a
chance to share experiences, gain understanding, and connect with others facing similar challenges
in a supportive and welcoming environment.

[Learn More][37]
[Brain Injury Hope Magazine]

### **Community Resources for Brain Injury Caregivers**

Being a caregiver is challenging, but you don’t have to face it alone. Our in-person and online
support groups are here to offer you connection, understanding, and guidance. Whether you need
someone to talk to, practical advice, or just a community that gets it, we’re here for you. Discover
our gatherings, social communities, and resources that make caregiving a bit more manageable and
supported.

[Learn More][38]
[bihn]

#### ** Our Facebook Family**

One of the world's largest online social communities offering support to those affected by brain
injury. 

[ Learn More ][39]
[Brain Injury books]

#### ** Brain Injury Books**

Browse the best brain injury books as recommended by survivors and those who love them!

[ Learn More ][40]
[brain injury blog]

#### ** BIHN Blog**

*Community Voices* is the official blog of BIHN, featuring survivor stories that remind us that
recovery is possible.

[ View Blog][41]

## Celebrating 13 Years of Hope!

BIHN celebrated a significant milestone on January 4th, 2026, commemorating twelve years of
dedicated service. We take pride in being the world's most engaged community, providing
comprehensive support to everyone impacted by brain injuries.

Our network is a welcoming space for survivors, their families, caregivers, and anyone seeking to
understand more about brain injuries. We warmly invite you to join us on this journey of hope,
healing, and learning.

[Join Us on Facebook>>>][42]

[Mobirise]

# Sign Up for Updates!

Stay connected with BIHN through our email newsletter. Sign up now to receive updates directly to
your inbox, including notifications of new stories shared by our community, reminders for upcoming
support group meetings, information on events, and much more.

# World leading supplier of innovative medical technology for patient monitoring

Since 1987, Compumedics’ strategy has focused on developing its core competency – Sleep Diagnostics
– which has enabled the company to become one of the leaders in this growing international
healthcare market. Today, Compumedics has evolved into one of the world’s leading suppliers of
medical technology for sleep and neuro diagnostics (including brain research) and ultrasonic blood
flow monitoring.

Compumedics’ technologies and products are distributed to clients around the globe, helping millions
of people who suffer from debilitating sleep, neurological and other healthcare problems.

Compumedics is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange since 2000 – ASX: CMP.

# Portable Brain Imaging

[ Interested? Let's talk ][6]

Cortirio’s mission is to save lives by developing low-cost, portable brain imaging. Our wearable
headset uses infrared light to map blood and automatically detect stroke and traumatic brain injury.
Faster and more accurate diagnosis saves time and lives.

[Brain scan]

## Technology

Infrared brain monitoring is a tool that has been used in medical research for many years.
Cortirio’s technology increases the spatial resolution of infrared monitoring to give true medical
imaging in a portable and wearable device. Like computer-aided tomography did for X-ray, we are
leveraging advances in technology to push an established technique for examining the brain to new
levels.

### Low-cost:

making imaging accessible to everyone

### Portable:

making imaging accessible everywhere

### Fast:

diagnosis on-site in 2 minutes

### Continuous monitoring:

raises alarm if patient deteriorates

# Accessible imaging, for every patient, everywhere

We aim to revolutionise stroke care worldwide.

# Developing a world first portable brain scanner

Bringing electromagnetic neurodiagnostics to the scene.
[ Learn more ][17]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the point-of-care

When stroke is suspected, rapid diagnosis is critical. Our world-first bedside electromagnetic
imaging device readily delivers imaging to the patient. Fast, AI-powered identification of stroke
type accelerates the appropriate treatment to better conserve brain matter.
[ How it works ][18]

## Bringing neurodiagnostics to the patient, wherever they are

###### Portable

Easily manoeuvred, easily stored, just like a cart Ultrasound

###### Safe

No ionizing radiation, no ferromagnetism, no special infrastructure or shielding requirements

###### Bedside operation

Perform scans at the bedside, without needing to move equipment or transport the patient

###### Fast

Scans and neurodiagnostic output obtained in just a few minutes

###### Easy to operate

One headset for all head sizes, simple pre-set positioning, push to scan

#### emu^{™} Brain Scanner

Detect clinically significant changes, at the bedside, when time matters.

#### First Responder Brain Scanner

Ultra light weight device embedded in standard road and air ambulances to deliver pre-hospital
stroke diagnosis and care to patients regardless of location.

Disclaimer: Neither the emu^{™} or first responder devices are available for sale or clinical use.
The devices’ safety, effectiveness and compliance
with regulatory requirements have not yet been evaluated by any regulatory authority.

## CONCUSSION IS A SILENT EPIDEMIC

More than 60 million people worldwide sustain a concussion each year, with 50% going undetected or
undiagnosed (World Health Organization).

Missed concussions can delay recovery, raise the risk of re-injury, and contribute to long-term
neurological symptoms. Yet diagnosis still relies heavily on subjective testing—symptoms, balance,
and memory—rather than direct measurement of brain function.

Headsafe™'s Nurochek™ changes the paradigm.

### Objective Results

Proprietary algorithms analyze over 400,000 data points to produce an objective measure of brain
function, supporting confident clinical decisions.

### 2-Minute Assessment

Delivers objective data in just two minutes. Fast enough for the busiest ER or sideline without
disrupting your workflow.

### FDA Cleared

Protected by 7 international patents and validated through multi-site studies across Australia, New
Zealand, and the United States.

### Portable & Practical

Brings neuroscience out of the lab and into the real world. On the sideline, in urgent care, or in
the neuro clinic.

### No Baseline Required

Unlike cognitive tests, Nurochek™ works without a pre-injury baseline. Assess anyone*, anytime,
without prior data.

Developed over 8 years of proprietary research, interpreting subtle brain-response patterns
invisible to the naked eye.

# Brain imaging AI that supports neurology care

## From complex scans to clear, actionable insights.

[Speak with an expert ][53]

###### Trusted by leading healthcare providers worldwide 

[AI-detecting brain]
[brain visual AI detecting]

#### Helping set the global standard in brain imaging AI

Longitudinal brain MRI monitoring is crucial for timely diagnoses and life-changing therapeutic
decisions - but tracking subtle changes can be challenging and time-consuming.

 

The AI-driven, validated, and FDA-cleared icobrain solutions assist radiologists and neurologists
with comparing and quantifying brain MRI scans over time.

# Complex Mental Health and Acquired Brain Injury service provider

[Services][6]

### About Us

### Maple House is a community based, purpose built, independent rehabilitation service for men with
### complex mental health needs including acquired brain injury. It is situated in the heart of
### Warrington with excellent transport links and is easily accessible. We focus on nurturing a
### positive and therapeutic environment that enables recovery and helps people fulfil their
### individual potential.

#### Services

Maple House is a 21 bed inpatient service that provides high quality, holistic, person-centred
rehabilitative care and specialised treatment for men with complex mental health needs due to mental
illness and/or acquired brain injury.

#### Our Goal

Our goal is to enable each of the men in our care to achieve meaningful and sustainable recovery and
fulfil his individual potential to the maximum extent. We help them make positive change in their
lives and to gain greater independence, long-term mental wellbeing and successful reintegration into
their community at their earliest opportunity.

#### We Offer

We offer an effective alternative to higher levels of secure care and aim to make a positive
difference in the lives of all those we support. With an individualised, person centred approach; we
can tailor the rehabilitation programme to the goals of the men in our care. Where appropriate and
agreed, we can also provide a managed individualised pathway to our affiliate supported living
service.

### Service Inclusion Criteria

> Males aged 18 years plus.
> 
> Informal, Detained under the Mental Health Act or Mental capacity Act
> 
> Complex mental health needs due to mental illness or acquired brain injury
> 
> May have more than one diagnosis
> 
> May be deemed a risk to themselves and/or others
> 
> May have a history of treatment resistance
> 
> Deemed suitable for rehabilitation in a non-secure setting

## Making an Impact

We drive military-civilian partnerships and foster collaboration within an extensive ecosystem of
small and large businesses, federal agencies, academic institutions, and more. Our collaborative
approach - enabled by a flexible Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) - expedites the development of
cutting-edge medical technologies essential to improving military and civilian health.

[Join MTEC][28]

### Funding

Efficient access to government funding opportunities through MTEC’s OTA—designed to reduce
administrative burden and speed time-to-award.

### Collaboration

Partnering & teaming opportunities on groundbreaking research and prototype efforts having
commercial potential.

### Guidance

Step-by-step guidance throughout the required government vetting, certification, and contracting
process.

### Access

An active voice in the future direction of military and civilian medical technology development.

# When Speed and Accuracy Matter, NanoDx™ Delivers

The NanoDx™ System is a first-of-its-kind diagnostic technology that combines nanotechnology and
biochemistry in a nano biosensor platform to address unmet testing needs.

### Clinical Value

Accelerate treatment decisions with accurate, real-time test results.

### Operational Value

Treat more patients in less time and bring the test to the patient.

### Financial Value

Reduce costly lab testing, avoid unnecessary diagnostic procedures.

### Health Equity

Bring accurate testing to both developed and underserved areas.

### Rapid Innovation

New test applications developed in just 6 to 9 months.

### Versatility

From military use to urgent care to sports medicine and more.

## One Platform, Multiple Applications

Patented nano biosensor technology enables accurate detection of biomarkers with a small blood
sample, in minutes. Extensive multiplexing capability and readily adjustable biomarker panel
configuration enable applications across a wide range of clinical indications.

[Learn More][24]

**Potential Future Applications (Directional)**

## First Focus: Traumatic Brain Injury (TBI)

Our TBI test, the first in an expanding portfolio, addresses the need for an accurate, quantitative
assessment of brain injury.* It replaces subjective evaluation with a real-time measurement of three
key TBI biomarkers.

[Learn More about TBI][25]

## Believing in Recovery for More Than 45 Years

Centre for Neuro Skills^{®} was founded on the philosophy that patients never stop improving. Our
specially trained clinicians and rehabilitation teams create individualized treatment plans and
define success based on who our patients were before they required rehabilitation. The results have
made us a world leader in neuro rehab.

We’re proud to offer therapeutic rehabilitation and disease management services for individuals
recovering from acquired and traumatic brain injury, and we’re even prouder that no two of our
rehabilitation plans are ever the same.

# Научно-технологический центр АвИ

— российская компания, входящая в реестр малых технологических компаний (МТК) и реестр малых
субъектов предпринимательства (МСП). Основные направления деятельности - научные исследования и
разработки, разработка программного обеспечения, специальный дизайн и работа с данными в
биомедицинской сфере.

Мы не только активно развиваем свои собственные проекты, но и предлагаем выполнение R&D работ на
заказ.

## About Physiopedia

Physiopedia is the world’s leading online knowledge platform for physiotherapy and rehabilitation
professionals. It brings together evidence-based clinical content, practical resources, and
continuing education to support learning, decision-making, and better patient outcomes. Built and

# Portapps

Collection of portable apps for Windows [   Apps ][8] [   Github ][9]

## What is Portapps ?

**Portapps** is a collection of [portable applications][10] for Windows. You can download your
favorite application as a portable setup or a 7z archive. Each portable app is executed through a
wrapper `[appname]-portable.exe` written in [Golang][11].

It is free and open source and always will be . All kinds of contributions are welcome ! The most
basic way to show your support is to star the project, or to raise issues You can also support this
project by [**becoming a sponsor on GitHub**][12] or by making a [Paypal donation][13] to ensure
this journey continues indefinitely!

#### about Precision MRI Group

## We are the ultimate in convenience and technology.

At Precision MRI Group, we place a strong focus on patient safety, comfort, and quality care. Our
friendly and knowledgeable team creates a calm and professional environment, ensuring every patient
feels supported throughout their visit. We are proud to offer advanced MRI services along with DTI
(Diffusion Tensor Imaging), a specialized form of imaging that provides detailed insights into brain
structure and neurological conditions.

Our Board Certified Radiologist delivers accurate MRI and DTI reports within 24 to 48 hours, with
immediate processing available for urgent cases. To make your experience even more convenient, we
offer free transportation upon request and flexible scheduling, including late evening and weekend
appointments to fit your lifestyle.

With English, Spanish, and Creole-speaking staff, we are here to assist with all your medical
imaging needs and ensure clear communication every step of the way. At Precision MRI Group, our goal
is to make your MRI and DTI experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. Call our caring team
today to schedule your appointment!

[ More About Us ][29]
[Precision MRI]
what we do

## Comprehensive MRI and DTI Scans

Precision MRI provides advanced diagnostic imaging using state-of-the-art MRI technology for
accurate and timely results. Our services support neurological, musculoskeletal, and whole-body
imaging with a focus on patient comfort and precise clinical insight.

### GE HiField 1.5 MRI

The GE HiField 1.5 Tesla MRI system provides high-resolution imaging for accurate diagnosis. It
supports neuro, musculoskeletal, and abdominal imaging with faster scans, improved comfort, and
clear results for confident treatment planning.

[ View Details ][30]
[ [Diffusion Tensor Imaging] ][31]

### Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)

Precision MRI is expanding its neurological imaging with Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI), an advanced
MRI technique used to evaluate traumatic brain injury, stroke, neurodegenerative disease, and
complex neurological conditions not visible on standard MRI.

[ View Details ][32]
[ [Inclusivity in Imaging: Navigating Open MRI for Bariatric and Plus-Size Patients] ][33]

### Tesla MRI

Tesla MRI systems, including 1.5T and 3T, provide exceptional image clarity for accurate diagnosis.
Higher-strength 3T imaging captures fine details, supporting advanced detection in oncology,
cardiology, and functional imaging for more precise, personalized care.

[ View Details ][34]

## What Our MRI Centers Offer

Visit one of our four offices conveniently located throughout South Florida. We have offices in
Pembroke Pines, Cypress Creek, Lake Worth and Port St. Lucie.

### LATE NIGHT & WEEKEND APPOINTMENTS

Our caring personnel will schedule your MRI appointment at a time that best accommodates your needs.
Even if it’s after hours or on a weekend.

### SAME DAY APPOINTMENTS AVAILABLE

Precision MRI’s Board Certified Radiologist offers a 24-48 hour turnaround time on your MRI report,
with immediate results available upon request.

### TRANSPORTATION PROVIDED ON REQUEST

We place a high premium on providing the utmost in quality patient care. That’s why we offer free
transportation for our patients.

FREE E-BOOK

## Take Control of Your Health Today!

Experience the difference with Precision MRI Group. Schedule your MRI with us and benefit from our
expertise, efficiency, convenience, and personalized care. Don’t wait prioritize your health and
well-being now.

#### about Precision MRI Group

## We are the ultimate in convenience and technology.

At Precision MRI Group, we place a strong focus on patient safety, comfort, and quality care. Our
friendly and knowledgeable team creates a calm and professional environment, ensuring every patient
feels supported throughout their visit. We are proud to offer advanced MRI services along with DTI
(Diffusion Tensor Imaging), a specialized form of imaging that provides detailed insights into brain
structure and neurological conditions.

Our Board Certified Radiologist delivers accurate MRI and DTI reports within 24 to 48 hours, with
immediate processing available for urgent cases. To make your experience even more convenient, we
offer free transportation upon request and flexible scheduling, including late evening and weekend
appointments to fit your lifestyle.

With English, Spanish, and Creole-speaking staff, we are here to assist with all your medical
imaging needs and ensure clear communication every step of the way. At Precision MRI Group, our goal
is to make your MRI and DTI experience as smooth and stress-free as possible. Call our caring team
today to schedule your appointment!

## Comprehensive MRI and DTI Scans

Precision MRI provides advanced diagnostic imaging using state-of-the-art MRI technology for
accurate and timely results. Our services support neurological, musculoskeletal, and whole-body
imaging with a focus on patient comfort and precise clinical insight.

### GE HiField 1.5 MRI

The GE HiField 1.5 Tesla MRI system provides high-resolution imaging for accurate diagnosis. It
supports neuro, musculoskeletal, and abdominal imaging with faster scans, improved comfort, and
clear results for confident treatment planning.

[ View Details ][30]
[ [Diffusion Tensor Imaging] ][31]

### Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI)

Precision MRI is expanding its neurological imaging with Diffusion Tensor Imaging (DTI), an advanced
MRI technique used to evaluate traumatic brain injury, stroke, neurodegenerative disease, and
complex neurological conditions not visible on standard MRI.

[ View Details ][32]
[ [Inclusivity in Imaging: Navigating Open MRI for Bariatric and Plus-Size Patients] ][33]

### Tesla MRI

Tesla MRI systems, including 1.5T and 3T, provide exceptional image clarity for accurate diagnosis.
Higher-strength 3T imaging captures fine details, supporting advanced detection in oncology,
cardiology, and functional imaging for more precise, personalized care.

[ View Details ][34]

### About Mental Health America

Mental Health America (MHA) – founded in 1909 – is the nation’s leading community-based nonprofit
dedicated to addressing the needs of those living with mental illness and to promoting the overall
mental health of all Americans. Our work is driven by our commitment to promote mental health as a
critical part of overall wellness, including prevention services for all; early identification and
intervention for those at risk; integrated care, services, and supports for those who need it; with
recovery as the goal.

MHA Screening is made possible through the generous contributions of individuals and organizations
that share our vision of mental health for all. This program is supported, in part, through
philanthropic contributions from Abbvie, Alkermes, Elevance Health Foundation, Johnson & Johnson,
The NFL Foundation, Sage Therapeutics, Takeda Lundbeck Alliance, and Teva.

## Welcome to StressTherapy Solutions

 



StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is an educational marketing company; specializing in workshops and
lectures on the subjects of biofeedback, EEG (electroencephalograph) brainwave training, QEEG
(Quantitative electroencephalograph), Database Guided Training, sLORETA Training, clinical ethics
and marketing guidance, personal mind fitness, and brainwave monitored meditation and neurofeedback
(EEG biofeedback) use in the clinical setting.

Since the 1980s, we have facilitated training and education by choosing independent specialists:
First with allopathics, then expanding to the neurofeedback community in 2001, to present workshops
to licensed practitioners, researchers, and educators. StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is the only
company to introduce the Global Neurofeedback Initiative, a collective that aims to promote
worldwide excellence, certification, and consistency in neurofeedback education.

## Welcome to StressTherapy Solutions

 



StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is an educational marketing company; specializing in workshops and
lectures on the subjects of biofeedback, EEG (electroencephalograph) brainwave training, QEEG
(Quantitative electroencephalograph), Database Guided Training, sLORETA Training, clinical ethics
and marketing guidance, personal mind fitness, and brainwave monitored meditation and neurofeedback
(EEG biofeedback) use in the clinical setting.

Since the 1980s, we have facilitated training and education by choosing independent specialists:
First with allopathics, then expanding to the neurofeedback community in 2001, to present workshops
to licensed practitioners, researchers, and educators. StressTherapy Solutions, Inc. is the only
company to introduce the Global Neurofeedback Initiative, a collective that aims to promote
worldwide excellence, certification, and consistency in neurofeedback education.

California, plays a pivotal role in fueling the growth of the startup ecosystem. With approximately
400 members and five angel funds, TCA has the resources and expertise to support startups through
seed, bridge, and early A-round funding.

TCA seeks companies with innovative solutions to meaningful problems—those that offer clear,
sustainable, and differentiated advantages. Our investments span a wide range of industries (see our
portfolio for details).

Beyond funding, TCA provides early-stage entrepreneurs with the critical tools for success:
connections, mentorship, knowledge, and operational support. While we work with startups across the
U.S. and Canada, we prioritize supporting California-based entrepreneurs with bold, game-changing
ideas.

Through our affiliation with over 50 angel groups nationwide, TCA has the ability to syndicate
deals, further amplifying the opportunities we create for startups.

# Turning Point is a safe place where ALL survivors of domestic and intimate partner abuse and their
# children can find refuge.

Turning Point provides confidential resources and support for individuals and families in Lehigh and
Northampton counties. In fiscal year 2024–2025, we served more than 3,772 Lehigh Valley residents
through our trauma-informed, inclusive programs, which include: a 24-hour Helpline, Emergency Safe
House, Empowerment Counseling and Groups, Legal Advocacy, Education and Training, and Medical
Advocacy.

Welcome to Vinfen

## The provider, employer, and partner of choice.

Established in 1977, Vinfen is a nonprofit, health and human services organization and a leading
provider of community-based services to individuals with mental health conditions, intellectual and
developmental disabilities, brain injuries, and behavioral health challenges. Our services and
advocacy promote the recovery, resiliency, habilitation, and self-determination of the people we
serve.

## THIS IS VINFEN

Vinfen is one of the most dynamic and innovative health and human services organizations in the
country. With over 500+ locations in Massachusetts and Connecticut, we are a premier provider of
comprehensive services for adolescents and adults with disabilities or life challenges. We provide a
wide range of evidence-based programs in recovery, supported living, habilitation, education,
employment, clinical, and peer support to the populations we serve.

## The provider, employer, and partner of choice.

Established in 1977, Vinfen is a nonprofit, health and human services organization and a leading
provider of community-based services to individuals with mental health conditions, intellectual and
developmental disabilities, brain injuries, and behavioral health challenges. Our services and
advocacy promote the recovery, resiliency, habilitation, and self-determination of the people we
serve.

## THIS IS VINFEN

Vinfen is one of the most dynamic and innovative health and human services organizations in the
country. With over 500+ locations in Massachusetts and Connecticut, we are a premier provider of
comprehensive services for adolescents and adults with disabilities or life challenges. We provide a
wide range of evidence-based programs in recovery, supported living, habilitation, education,
employment, clinical, and peer support to the populations we serve.
